rows.text: Article 1: a commission called the Allegiance Commission (هيئة البيعة) is constituted by royal order from the sons of the founder King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al-Faisal Al Saud; one son, appointed by the King, of each son who has died, excused himself or is medically incapacitated; and two members appointed by the King, one of his sons and one of the Crown Prince's sons. The King fills vacancies.

rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: Article 5: the chairman, the members and the secretary general of the Commission take the prescribed oath before the King before they begin their work in the Commission.
